exam.title: CPA C++ Certified Associate Programmer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published, but CPE-level procedural C++ is practical preparation. Practice compile-and-trace work across types, conversions, operators, strings and aggregates, structured control and exceptions, overloads and macros, pointer ownership, class invariants, constructors/copying, inheritance, virtual dispatch, casts, operator overloading and namespaces. Recognize legacy throw() while using current RAII/noexcept practices in new code.

review.notes: All 35 CPA-21-02 objectives are mapped through types/literals/conversions/operators, strings/aggregates, flow and exception unwinding, overload/default/parameter/macro behavior, pointer ranges and ownership, class invariants and special members, inheritance/access/dispatch/casts, operator overloading, friends and namespaces. Three scenarios, eight labs and 30 original checks are included. Legacy throw() recognition is kept separate from modern RAII/noexcept practice, and the official aligned course's CLA-21-02 field typo is flagged. O'Reilly and Udemy are automation-blocked; no link is missing. No recalled/live item, answer dump or copied course question is used. September 29 CPE source-health refresh updated shared-link counts only; this guide content and review date were not re-reviewed.

findings.title: Numbered objectives and normalized score need explicit scope
findings.evidence: The active syllabus has 35 numbered objectives, 40 questions and a 200-point normalized maximum.
findings.recommendation: Map every objective, retain weights and explain weighted scoring without inventing a raw correct-answer count.
findings.resolution: Map every objective, retain weights and explain weighted scoring without inventing a raw correct-answer count.

findings.title: Exception-specification removal requires two dates
findings.evidence: Typed throw(T) is removed in C++17; empty throw() remains a deprecated alias until removal in C++20.
findings.recommendation: Provide the historical matrix and retain both compilers accepting the removed form as an observation, not a conformance claim.
findings.resolution: Provide the historical matrix and retain both compilers accepting the removed form as an observation, not a conformance claim.

findings.title: Vague sizeof exceptions obscure the ISO rule
findings.evidence: The expression operand is unevaluated in ISO C++; type/access constraints still apply.
findings.recommendation: Replace the vague answer and execute a function-call operand without incrementing its counter.
findings.resolution: Replace the vague answer and execute a function-call operand without incrementing its counter.

findings.title: Ownership explanation lacks a complete failure-safe implementation
findings.evidence: Memberwise raw-pointer copying does not implement unique ownership or preserve a destination on failed deep copy.
findings.recommendation: Supply a bounded multi-file rule-of-five owner with independent copies, copy-and-swap, self-assignment, moves, injected failure and rule-of-zero comparison.
findings.resolution: Supply a bounded multi-file rule-of-five owner with independent copies, copy-and-swap, self-assignment, moves, injected failure and rule-of-zero comparison.

findings.title: Virtual dispatch and default selection need separate reasoning
findings.evidence: Defaults follow static call-site declarations, while virtual calls can select a derived implementation.
findings.recommendation: Execute base/derived defaults, qualified calls, slicing and constructor dispatch; add strict override diagnostics.
findings.resolution: Execute base/derived defaults, qualified calls, slicing and constructor dispatch; add strict override diagnostics.

findings.title: String and vector boundaries need concrete distinctions
findings.evidence: String size-position access differs between at and operator[], while reserve changes capacity and may invalidate observers.
findings.recommendation: Add substring/access/insertion and vector checks without stale access or assumptions that compare returns exactly one.
findings.resolution: Add substring/access/insertion and vector checks without stale access or assumptions that compare returns exactly one.

source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-exception-handlers: Complete N4659 except.handle, sixteen paragraphs, read. Handler matching/order, public unambiguous bases, no ordinary arithmetic conversion, rethrow identity, unhandled termination and constructor function-try-block restrictions. source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-dynamic-cast: Complete N4659 expr.dynamic.cast, nine paragraphs, read. source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-static-cast: Complete N4659 expr.static.cast, thirteen paragraphs, read. Hierarchy preconditions, virtual-base restrictions and conversion limits. source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-sizeof: Complete N4659 expr.sizeof, six paragraphs and notes, read. Unevaluated operand, no array-to-pointer conversion, reference referent size, invalid function/incomplete/bitfield cases and size_t result. Replaced vague exceptions wording with the ISO C++ rule and an actual unevaluated function-call check.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-constructor-initialization: Complete N4659 class.base.init, eighteen paragraphs, read. Virtual/direct base and member order, delegating construction, default initializers and construction-time restrictions. Workbook uses declared order and bounded normal/failed construction traces.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-copy-construction: Complete N4659 class.copy.ctor, fifteen paragraphs, read. Copy/move forms, generated memberwise operations, suppression/deletion, triviality and order. Original Buffer implements explicit deep copy/move contracts; vector counterpart uses rule of zero.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-copy-assignment: Complete N4659 class.copy.assign, thirteen paragraphs, read. Copy/move assignment forms, implicit suppression/deletion, bases/members and virtual-base caveats. Original copy-and-swap owner tests self-assignment and injected failure preservation.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-delete: Complete N4659 expr.delete, twelve paragraphs, read. Scalar/array pairing, null, virtual base deletion requirements, reverse array destruction and deallocation selection. No mismatch, double deletion or nonvirtual base deletion executed.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-new: Complete N4659 expr.new, twenty-four paragraphs, read in two bounded parts. Allocation/initialization, zero arrays, bad bounds, throwing/nothrow behavior, alignment/placement and construction-failure deallocation. No actual exhaustion, replacement allocator or placement-lifetime experiment.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-virtual-functions: Complete N4659 class.virtual, sixteen paragraphs, read. Final overriders, signature cv/ref matching, override/final checks, covariant returns and qualified-call suppression. Workbook covers const overrides, default arguments, slicing and virtual deletion.
source_reading_boundaries.cpp17-default-arguments: Complete N4659 dcl.fct.default, ten paragraphs, read. Trailing defaults, same-scope declarations, binding/evaluation timing, function-type distinction and static-type defaults for virtual calls. Workbook observes base-default/derived-body behavior.
